GTM case studies

01
ABM Partner GTM FSI GenAI

Google Cloud & AWS

Joint GTM programmes with cloud hyperscalers using ABM

I have worked strategically with both AWS and GCP to design and execute joint co-marketing campaigns targeting FSI and AI workload migration opportunities. By building tailored messaging for each hyperscaler's partner motion, I created pipeline programmes that positioned cloud infrastructure as the natural home for modern quantitative finance and GenAI workloads.

02
PLG Open Source B2B SaaS Growth

Jetstack (acquired by Venafi)

Converting open source traction into $1M ARR SaaS

I founded the PMM function at Jetstack and launched the company's first B2B SaaS product — a commercial platform built on top of cert-manager, one of the most widely adopted open source Kubernetes security projects in the CNCF ecosystem. By identifying the commercial opportunity across Fortune 5000 accounts and designing the GTM that allowed Venafi to exploit this clear market opportunity before it was on anyone's roadmap, I built the GTM motion, messaging, and sales infrastructure that drove the SaaS product to $1M ARR by end of Year 2.

→ 03
Sales Enablement Category Creation Cloud Native Security

Venafi / CyberArk

Launching Workload Identity as a new security category

I led the product marketing strategy that positioned CyberArk as the category leader in cloud-native machine identity security. I built the technical and commercial narrative that made workload identity security an urgent board-level priority — bridging the gap between security teams and platform engineers who weren't communicating, and creating the GTM motion that drove ARR from $30M to $40M through the Secure Workload Access category launch.
